select jsonb_build_object(
 'database',current_database(),'version',version(),
 'roles',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',rolname,'bypassrls',rolbypassrls,'super',rolsuper,'login',rolcanlogin)) from pg_roles where rolname in ('garimpa_app','garimpa_public_runtime')),
 'tables',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',c.relname,'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'force',c.relforcerowsecurity) order by c.relname) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='garimpa' and c.relkind='r'),
 'policies',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) order by tablename,policyname) from pg_policies p where schemaname='garimpa'),
 'functions',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',p.proname,'definer',p.prosecdef,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'acl',p.proacl::text,'config',p.proconfig) order by p.proname) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='garimpa'),
 'counts',jsonb_build_object('accounts',(select count(*) from garimpa.affiliate_account),'products',(select count(*) from garimpa.product),'observations',(select count(*) from garimpa.price_observation),'publications',(select count(*) from garimpa.publication),'shortlinks',(select count(*) from garimpa.short_link),'clicks',(select count(*) from garimpa.click_event),'secrets',(select count(*) from garimpa.affiliate_secret)),
 'constraints',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',conrelid::regclass::text,'name',conname,'validated',convalidated,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(oid)) order by conname) from pg_constraint where connamespace='garimpa'::regnamespace)
) as audit;
